verdict.rationale: Chroma's core is Apache-2.0 OSS and can be run and prototyped with entirely for free locally/self-hosted, and Chroma Cloud offers $5 in free credits to try it in under 30 seconds; community feedback also praises the straightforward, reasonable pricing calculator. missing for 10: independent developer accounts specifically praising the free-tier prototyping experience over time, and clearer detail on free-tier usage limits/duration.
